name: ui-layouts-animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
blurb: Animated lines connect referenced elements with gradient trails.
description: Draws SVG paths between positioned elements with continuous motion animation. Paths can be reversed, curved, and rendered as dotted lines.
use_when: Illustrating connections or data flow between nodes in a diagram, dashboard, or network visualization.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts with many instances—each runs a continuous animation loop.
a11y: Purely decorative SVG; no interactive elements. Container and endpoint refs must be positioned.
